q19927.en: The sign shown is a regulatory sign.

explain.short: Round signs with a red border give orders or bans. 'No parking' is one of them, so it is a 'prescrizione' (regulatory) sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means a rule you must obey, not just information.

sceneParams.caption: A regulatory sign: no parking

q19928.en: The sign shown is not placed where parking is already banned by a general rule.

explain.short: Where the law already bans parking (for example on pedestrian crossings or at junctions), no sign is needed.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'per regola generale' means by the general law: there the ban applies even without a sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not needed where the law already bans parking

q19929.en: The sign shown forbids leaving the vehicle for a long time.

explain.short: 'Sosta' (parking) means leaving the vehicle for a long time, often with the driver away. That is what this sign bans.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'abbandono prolungato' (leaving for a long time) is the meaning of 'sosta', so it is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Bans leaving the car parked for long

q19930.en: The sign shown, placed in built-up areas, as a rule forbids parking from 8.00 to 20.00.

explain.short: In towns, if no panel gives other times, the no-parking ban applies from 8.00 to 20.00.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'di norma' means as a rule: a panel can set different hours.

sceneParams.caption: In towns: no parking 8.00-20.00 as a rule

q19931.en: Sign (A), completed by panel (B), allows buses to park.

explain.short: Panel B says 'eccetto' (except) with a bus: the parking ban applies to everyone except buses.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'eccetto' on the panel creates an exception: buses may park.

sceneParams.caption: No parking, except buses

q19932.en: Sign (A), completed by panel (B), forbids parking only on public holidays.

explain.short: The cross on panel B stands for Sundays and public holidays: the ban applies only on those days, from 8.00 to 20.00.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is right here: the cross symbol limits the ban to holidays.

sceneParams.caption: Cross = only on holidays, 8.00-20.00

q19933.en: The sign shown forbids parking but not stopping.

explain.short: One red bar means no parking. A short stop (fermata), for example to let someone get out, is still allowed.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'sosta' (parking) and 'fermata' (short stop) are different: only 'sosta' is banned.

sceneParams.caption: No parking, but a short stop is OK

q19934.en: The sign shown forbids a brief halt to let passengers get on and off.

explain.short: A brief halt for passengers is a 'fermata' (stop), and this sign does not ban it. It bans only parking.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'sospensione temporanea della marcia' is the meaning of 'fermata', which is allowed here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: stopping for passengers is allowed

q19935.en: On roads outside built-up areas, the sign shown applies only in daytime hours.

explain.short: Outside towns the no-parking ban applies day and night. The 8.00-20.00 rule is only for towns.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'soltanto nelle ore diurne' (only in daytime) is wrong: outside towns it is 24 hours.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: outside towns it applies 24 hours

q19936.en: The sign shown forbids vehicles to park on both sides of the carriageway.

explain.short: The sign applies only on the side of the road where it stands. The other side needs its own sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'su ambo i lati' (on both sides) is wrong: only the side of the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only on the side where the sign stands

q19937.en: The sign shown allows buses to park.

explain.short: Without an extra panel, the ban applies to every vehicle, buses too. Only an 'eccetto' (except) panel can free buses.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'permette' (allows) is wrong: without a panel, buses cannot park either.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: without a panel, buses can't park either

q19938.en: The sign shown allows mopeds to park.

explain.short: The ban applies to all vehicles, mopeds included, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): one red bar on blue. You may stop briefly (fermata) but not park (sosta); in towns 8.00-20.00 as a rule, outside towns 24 hours, only on the sign's side.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' (mopeds) are vehicles too: there is no exception for them.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: mopeds can't park here either

q19939.en: The sign shown forbids a brief halt of the vehicle.

explain.short: A brief halt is a 'fermata' (stop), and the red X bans exactly that.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'temporanea sospensione della marcia' is the meaning of 'fermata': banned here.

sceneParams.caption: Not even a brief stop is allowed

q19940.en: The sign shown forbids all vehicles from stopping voluntarily.

explain.short: No vehicle may choose to stop here. Stopping because of traffic, in a queue or at a red light, is not a 'fermata'.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'volontaria' (voluntary): stops you choose are banned, stops forced by traffic are not.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicle may choose to stop here

q19941.en: On the roads where it is placed, the sign shown applies 24 hours a day.

explain.short: Without a panel showing hours, the no-stopping ban applies day and night, in and out of towns.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: '24 ore su 24' is right: unlike no parking, there is no 8.00-20.00 window.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping, day and night

q19942.en: The sign shown forbids parking but allows stopping.

explain.short: The red X bans both parking and stopping. Only the single-bar sign allows a short stop.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'consente la fermata' is wrong: with the X, even a short stop is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the X bans stopping too

q19943.en: On urban roads, the sign shown means the no-stopping ban applies from 8.00 to 20.00.

explain.short: The no-stopping ban applies 24 hours a day, in towns too. The 8.00-20.00 rule belongs to the no-parking sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.00 alle 20.00' is the trap: those hours belong to the no-parking sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it applies 24 hours, in towns too

q19944.en: The sign shown allows stopping to let passengers get on or off.

explain.short: Stopping to let people in or out is a 'fermata', and the red X bans every stop.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'per far salire o scendere passeggeri' does not make it allowed: it is still a stop.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no stop, not even for passengers

keywords.en: to let get on or off

q19945.en: The sign shown allows stopping if the vehicle does not obstruct traffic.

explain.short: The no-stopping ban has no exception for harmless stops. Even if you block nobody, you may not stop.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. No vehicle may stop or park, not even briefly, 24 hours a day unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'se il veicolo non arreca intralcio' (if it does not obstruct) is a fake condition here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no stopping, even without blocking anyone

q19946.en: The sign shown forbids parking both by day and by night, even in built-up areas.

explain.short: If you may not stop, you may not park either. The no-stopping ban applies 24 hours, in towns too.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'anche nei centri abitati' (even in towns) is right: there is no 8.00-20.00 window here.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping or parking, day and night

keywords.it: sia di giorno che di notte
keywords.en: both by day and by night

q19947.en: The sign shown forbids all vehicles to stop.

explain.short: The red X applies to every vehicle: cars, buses, taxis, motorbikes.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli' is right: without a panel no category is exempt.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicle may stop here

q19948.en: The sign shown, when there are no extra inscriptions, applies for the whole 24 hours.

explain.short: With no panel giving hours, the no-stopping ban applies all day and all night.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'in assenza di iscrizioni integrative' means 'with no extra panel': then it is 24 hours.

sceneParams.caption: No panel = valid 24 hours

q19949.en: The sign shown forbids any voluntary stop of the vehicle.

explain.short: Any stop you choose to make is banned here, even a very short one.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi' (any) is right: no chosen stop is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Any chosen stop is banned

q19950.en: Where the sign shown is present, tow-away of the vehicle is always ordered.

explain.short: Where stopping is banned, a stopped vehicle is a danger for traffic, so the law provides for towing it away, even without an extra panel.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is accepted here: under a no-stopping sign, tow-away is always foreseen.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping: the car can be towed away

q19950.reviewNote: Art. 159 CdS allows (not automatically orders) tow-away where stopping is banned; 'sempre disposta' kept as the official answer.

q19951.en: Sign (A), if completed by panel (B), forbids stopping on the stretch before it.

explain.short: The downward arrow on panel B means the ban covered the stretch you just drove, and it ends here.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'nel tratto precedente' (on the stretch before) matches the arrow pointing down.

sceneParams.caption: Down arrow: ban valid on the stretch before

q19952.en: Sign (A), if completed by panel (B), marks the end of the no-stopping and no-parking ban.

explain.short: The downward arrow means the ban stops at this sign: after it, this ban no longer applies.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'la fine' (the end) is right: the down arrow marks where the ban ends.

sceneParams.caption: Down arrow: end of the no-stopping zone

keywords.it: divieto di fermata e di sosta

q19953.en: The sign shown forbids stopping but allows parking.

explain.short: Parking lasts longer than stopping: if even a short stop is banned, parking is banned too.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'ma consente la sosta' is impossible: no stopping means no parking.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no stopping also means no parking

q19954.en: The sign shown does not apply to buses.

explain.short: The no-stopping ban applies to all vehicles, buses included, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'non vale' (does not apply) is wrong: buses must obey it too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: buses must obey it too

q19955.en: The sign shown does not apply to taxis.

explain.short: The no-stopping ban applies to all vehicles, taxis included: a taxi may not stop here to pick up or drop off.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'non vale' (does not apply) is wrong: taxis must obey it too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: taxis must obey it too

q19956.en: The sign shown is an advance warning of a no-parking ban.

explain.short: This sign does not warn about something ahead: it bans stopping and parking right where it stands.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'preavviso' (advance warning) is wrong: it is a ban in force from here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it bans stopping here, it doesn't warn

q19957.en: The sign shown applies only on working days, unless otherwise indicated.

explain.short: Without a panel, the no-stopping ban applies every day, holidays included, 24 hours a day.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'solo nei giorni feriali' (only on working days) is wrong: it applies every day.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it applies every day, holidays too

q19958.en: The sign shown allows the vehicle to stop to let passengers get on and off.

explain.short: Stopping for passengers is still a 'fermata', and the red X bans every stop.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'per la salita e la discesa dei passeggeri' does not make it allowed: it is still a stop.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no stop, not even for passengers

q19959.en: The sign shown announces the end of the no-parking ban.

explain.short: The plain red X bans stopping and parking from here on; it does not announce the end of anything.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di fermata' (no stopping): red X on blue. Every vehicle, every day, 24 hours: no stopping and so no parking, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia la fine' (announces the end) is wrong: only a panel with a down arrow marks an end.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it starts a no-stopping ban

q19960.en: The sign shown indicates an authorised car park.

explain.short: The white P on blue marks a place where parking is officially allowed.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'autorizzato' (authorised) is right: it is an official parking area.

sceneParams.caption: P = authorised parking area

q19961.en: The sign shown indicates an area equipped and organised for parking with no time limit, unless otherwise indicated.

explain.short: A car park is made for parking, and without an extra panel there is no time limit.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa indicazione' (unless otherwise indicated): a panel could add limits.

sceneParams.caption: Park with no time limit, unless a panel says so

q19962.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing its distance.

explain.short: When the car park is further on, a panel under the P can say how far away it is.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'la distanza' (the distance) is a normal panel for the P sign.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can show how far the car park is

q19963.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing the categories it is reserved for.

explain.short: A panel can reserve the car park for some vehicles, for example buses or motorbikes.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'riservata' (reserved): a panel can say who may use the car park.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can reserve it for some vehicles

q19964.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing the categories of vehicles excluded.

explain.short: A panel can also say which vehicles may NOT use the car park, for example lorries.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'esclusi' (excluded): a panel can keep some vehicles out.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can exclude some vehicles

q19965.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing its time limit.

explain.short: A panel can limit how long you may park, for example a maximum time.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'limitazione nel tempo' (time limit) is possible only with a panel; the P alone has none.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can set a time limit

q19966.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing the hours and the fees.

explain.short: If the car park has opening hours or you must pay, a panel under the P shows the hours and fees.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'l'orario e le tariffe' (hours and fees) can be shown on a panel.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can show hours and fees

q19967.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing how vehicles are arranged.

explain.short: A panel can show how to park: in line, side by side or at an angle.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'disposizione dei veicoli' (how vehicles are arranged) can be shown on a panel.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can show how to line up

q19968.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area with a parking meter.

explain.short: The plain P only says you may park. It says nothing about paying at a meter; that would need a panel.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'parchimetro' (parking meter) is not on the sign: nothing says you must pay.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the plain P says nothing about a meter

q19969.en: The sign shown indicates that parking is allowed from 8.00 to 20.00.

explain.short: The plain P has no hours: you may park at any time, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'dalle 8.00 alle 20.00' is invented: the sign shows no hours.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no hours shown, parking at any time

q19970.en: The sign shown indicates an area where you may park for one hour at most.

explain.short: The plain P has no time limit: you may park as long as you like, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'al massimo per un'ora' (one hour at most) is invented: no limit is shown.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no time limit is shown

q19971.en: The sign shown indicates free parking but no stopping.

explain.short: This makes no sense: if you may park, you may also stop. The P allows both.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'con divieto di fermata' (with no stopping) is the trap: the P bans nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the P allows parking and stopping

q19972.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area reserved for State Police vehicles.

explain.short: The plain P is for everyone. A reservation for some vehicles would need a panel.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'riservato' (reserved) is wrong: nothing on the sign reserves it.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the plain P is for everyone

q19973.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed by a panel showing the available surface area.

explain.short: Panels for the P show distance, categories, time limits, hours and fees, or layout. The size of the area is not one of them.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'la superficie disponibile' (the available area) is not a panel used with the P.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no panel shows the size of the area

q19974.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area and can be completed with an order to leave the key in the ignition.

explain.short: No panel tells you to leave your key in the car. In fact, when you park you should take the key with you.
explain.rule: The white P on blue marks an authorised parking area: you may park with no time limit, unless an extra panel adds limits.
explain.trap: 'lasciare la chiave nel quadro' (leave the key in the ignition) is an invented panel.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no panel says to leave the key

q19975.en: The sign shown announces that there is a car park in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: The P with an arrow tells you which way to go to find the car park.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'nella direzione della freccia' (in the direction of the arrow) is right: follow the arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Car park ahead: follow the arrow

q19976.en: The sign shown announces a parking zone if you go in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: Going the way the arrow points, you reach a parking zone.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'procedendo nel senso della freccia' (going the way of the arrow) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Parking zone the way the arrow points

q19977.en: The sign shown announces a car park 300 metres away in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: The panel under the sign says 300 m: the car park is 300 metres away, following the arrow.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'a 300 metri' is right: the distance is written on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Car park in 300 m, following the arrow

q19978.en: The sign shown announces a first-aid post in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: The white P means parking. First aid has a different sign (a red cross on white).
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'pronto soccorso' (first aid) is wrong: P means parking.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P means parking, not first aid

q19979.en: The sign shown announces a no-parking area in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: A blue sign with a white P invites you to park; it does not ban anything.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'vietato' (banned) is wrong: the P announces a place where you may park.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you may park there

q19980.en: The sign shown announces that parking is banned in the direction of the arrow.

explain.short: The P with an arrow leads you to a car park: parking there is allowed, not banned.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'sono vietati' (are banned) is wrong: the P allows parking.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: parking is allowed there

q19981.en: The sign shown tells you to drive on because the car park is reserved.

explain.short: Nothing on the sign says the car park is reserved: it simply shows where a car park is.
explain.rule: P with an arrow and a distance: a car park is ahead in the direction of the arrow, at the distance shown.
explain.trap: 'perché il parcheggio è riservato' (because it is reserved) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: nothing says it is reserved

q19982.en: The sign shown forbids parking at the place where it is placed.

explain.short: The 'passo carrabile' (driveway) sign keeps the entrance free: nobody may park in front of it.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'nel luogo dove è posto' (where it is placed) is right: the ban is right in front of the driveway.

sceneParams.caption: No parking in front of the driveway

q19983.en: The sign shown marks the area where vehicles enter side properties.

explain.short: A driveway is where cars enter and leave a property beside the road, for example a garage or a courtyard.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'proprietà laterali' (side properties) are the buildings and yards beside the road.

sceneParams.caption: Driveway: entrance to a side property

q19984.en: The sign shown marks the exit of a driveway.

explain.short: The sign says 'passo carrabile': vehicles come out of a property here.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'sbocco' (exit) is where vehicles come out onto the road.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicles come out of a driveway here

q19985.en: The sign shown allows stopping, as long as the vehicle does not obstruct.

explain.short: The sign bans parking, not stopping. A short stop is fine if you do not block the driveway or traffic.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'purché' (as long as) is the condition: stopping is OK only without obstructing.

sceneParams.caption: Short stop OK, if you block nobody

q19986.en: To be valid, the sign shown must show the authority that granted the permit, the number and the year it was issued.

explain.short: A driveway sign needs a permit from the local authority. The sign must show who granted it, the number and the year.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'per essere valido' (to be valid): without these details the sign has no value.

sceneParams.caption: Valid only with authority, number and year

q19987.en: The sign shown is placed only on urban roads.

explain.short: Driveways exist in towns and in the countryside, so the sign is used on all roads.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is wrong: it is also used outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is used on all roads

q19988.en: The sign shown applies only in daytime hours.

explain.short: Vehicles may need to come out at any time, so the driveway ban applies day and night.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'solo nelle ore diurne' (only by day) is wrong: it applies 24 hours.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it applies day and night

q19989.en: The sign shown applies only at night.

explain.short: Vehicles may need to come out at any time, so the driveway ban applies day and night.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'solo nelle ore notturne' (only at night) is wrong: it applies 24 hours.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it applies day and night

q19990.en: The sign shown allows certain categories of vehicles to park.

explain.short: The driveway must stay free for everyone: no type of vehicle may park in front of it.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'consente la sosta' (allows parking) is wrong: there are no exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: nobody may park there

q19991.en: The sign shown allows emergency vehicles that are not on duty to park.

explain.short: An ambulance that is not on an emergency is like any other vehicle: it may not park in front of a driveway.
explain.rule: 'Passo carrabile' (driveway): no parking for anyone, at any time; a short stop is allowed if it blocks nobody.
explain.trap: 'non in servizio' (not on duty): without an emergency there is no special right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: not even an off-duty ambulance

q19992.en: The sign shown allows vehicles serving disabled people, with the proper badge, to park.

explain.short: The P and the wheelchair under the no-parking disc mean: parking only for vehicles serving disabled people with the badge.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'munite dell'apposito contrassegno' (with the proper badge): the badge must be shown.

sceneParams.caption: Parking only for disabled people's vehicles

q19993.en: The sign shown is a regulatory sign.

explain.short: It contains a red no-parking disc: it gives an order about who may park, so it is a 'prescrizione' (regulatory) sign.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' means a rule you must obey, not just information.

sceneParams.caption: A regulatory sign: parking rule

q19994.en: The sign shown is a specific exception to the parking ban.

explain.short: The disc bans parking, and the panel below makes an exception for vehicles serving disabled people.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'eccezione' (exception): the ban stays, but one group is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No parking, except for disabled people

q19995.en: The sign shown does not allow parking to vehicles other than those serving disabled people.

explain.short: For everyone else the no-parking ban stays: only vehicles serving disabled people may park.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'veicoli diversi' (other vehicles): for them the ban is still in force.

sceneParams.caption: Other vehicles may not park here

q19996.en: The sign shown allows school buses to park.

explain.short: The wheelchair symbol means disabled people only. School buses have no exception here.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'scuolabus' (school buses) are not shown on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only disabled people's vehicles

q19997.en: The sign shown indicates a lane reserved for vehicles serving disabled people.

explain.short: It is about parking, not driving: it does not mark a lane.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'corsia' (lane) is wrong: the sign is about parking spaces.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is about parking, not a lane

q19998.en: The sign shown is a no-parking sign for vehicles serving disabled people, and shows the nearest car park.

explain.short: It is the opposite: disabled people's vehicles are the only ones that MAY park. It shows no other car park.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sosta per i veicoli al servizio di invalidi' turns the meaning upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: disabled people's vehicles MAY park

q19999.en: The sign shown warns of a zone closed to normal traffic because it is equipped for disabled people.

explain.short: The sign is about parking where it stands, not a warning of a closed zone ahead.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'preavvisa una zona vietata al traffico' is wrong: it does not close any road.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it only rules parking here

q20000.en: The sign shown, on the road where it is placed, allows only vehicles serving disabled people to drive through.

explain.short: The sign is about parking, not driving: every vehicle may still drive along the road.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'transito' (driving through) is wrong: only parking is reserved.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it rules parking, not driving

keywords.en: on the road where it is placed

q20001.en: The sign shown allows mopeds and motorcycles to park.

explain.short: Only vehicles serving disabled people may park. Mopeds and motorcycles have no exception.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori e motocicli' (mopeds and motorbikes) are not shown on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only disabled people's vehicles

q20002.en: The sign shown allows parking if you display a ticket from a parking meter.

explain.short: Paying does not help: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park here.
explain.rule: No-parking sign with P and wheelchair: only vehicles serving disabled people with the badge may park; everyone else may not.
explain.trap: 'tagliando emesso da un parchimetro' (meter ticket) gives no right to park here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a meter ticket doesn't help
